EmailTemplate.subject: PerformSmart - Exclude Employees
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName}
Thank you for contacting Insperity Technical Support.
When creating a review and excluding employees, for best results we recommend excluding by job title or job code rather than by employee name.
To exclude by job title or job code, please follow the steps below:
Click on Administration > Cycle Based Reviews. Click on the New Review button at the right to create a new review period. Complete the review period information. Scroll down to the Employee Exclusions section. Click on the Add icon next to Job Title. Select the Job Titles / Job Codes then click the add button. The selected employees are listed by expanding the Employee Exclusion List area at the bottom of the page so that you can review all your exclusion selections before saving. Deselect any employees who should be included in the review. Leave the check mark next to any employees who should be excluded.
To verify who is in the review, please run a Review Inclusion/Exclusion report.
If you have any questions or need anything further, please do not hesitate to contact us.
Kind Regards,
